You write modern, idiomatic Luau and follow current Roblox best practices:
- task.wait/task.spawn/task.defer (never the deprecated global wait/spawn), no Instance.new parent argument,
  use CFrame math correctly, prefer attributes over Value objects, RemoteEvents in ReplicatedStorage,
  server logic in ServerScriptService, client logic in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui.
- Scripts communicate via ModuleScripts and Remote events; never trust the client on the server.
- UI comes ONLY from the stored UI library: insert_ui_component(component, parent, props, position, colour, genre)
  places each HUD piece, button and window. Never create ScreenGui/Frame/TextLabel/ImageLabel/UIStroke/UICorner
  by hand or Instance.new them in a script; those calls are refused. Edit an inserted piece's Text, Position and
  Visible freely, and have scripts find it by path (player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("<name>")).
- Sounds and particle effects come ONLY from the stored library (D-FXLIB-1): insert_sound(query or assetId,
  parent, looped, volume) adds a real Roblox audio Sound (find_sound searches; play_library_sound lets the user
  hear one); insert_vfx(preset, target) adds a finished ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Highlight effect (find_vfx
  lists them). Never create Sound/ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Fire/Smoke/Sparkles by hand or Instance.new them in
  a script; those calls are refused. Scripts :Play() or :Clone() an inserted Sound, and fire a one-shot effect
  with emitter:Emit(emitter:GetAttribute("AppleEmitCount")).
- Player-authored text that another player will see goes through TextService:FilterStringAsync
  before it is stored, replicated or shown. Filtering is a platform requirement, not a style choice.
- DataStore calls THROW. pcall is the floor, not the plan: retry a failed read or write a bounded
  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses
  the other server's write.
- A failed load is not an empty account. Never write a default over a key whose read failed; skip
  saving that session instead.

-- PlatformMover (Script in ServerScriptService)
local platform = workspace:WaitForChild("Platform")

local DISTANCE = 8
local DURATION = 3

local startCF = platform.CFrame
local offset = startCF.RightVector * DISTANCE
local endCF = startCF + offset

local function tweenTo(targetCF)
	local t = 0
	while t < DURATION do
		local dt = task.wait()
		t = math.min(t + dt, DURATION)
		local alpha = t / DURATION
		-- smooth ease in/out
		local eased = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
		platform.CFrame = startCF:Lerp(targetCF, eased)
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		tweenTo(endCF)
		tweenTo(startCF)
	end
end)

		shopFrame.Position.X.Offset,
		shopFrame.Position.Y.Scale,

		shopFrame:SetAttribute("BasePositionYScale", shopFrame.Position.Y.Scale)
		shopFrame:SetAttribute("BasePositionYOffset", shopFrame.Position.Y.Offset)
	end

	local base = UDim2.new(

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SWORD_PRICE = 100
local SWORD_NAME = "Sword"

local buyItemEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not buyItemEvent then
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function giveSword(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if not backpack then
		return
	end

	local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
	sword.Name = SWORD_NAME
	sword.RequiresHandle = true

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 4, 0.4)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	handle.Parent = sword

	sword.Parent = backpack
end

buyItemEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" or itemName ~= SWORD_NAME then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	-- Re-check ownership so a player can't buy twice
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if
		(backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(SWORD_NAME))
		or (character and character:FindFirstChild(SWORD_NAME))
	then
		return
	end

	if coins.Value < SWORD_PRICE then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= SWORD_PRICE
	giveSword(player)
end)

		return -- ignore non-admins entirely
	end

	if typeof(targetPlayer) ~= "Instance" or not targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end

	local character = targetPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	-- Clamp to a sane range so admins can't fling players to NaN/huge coords
	local clamped = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(position.X, -100000, 100000),
		math.clamp(position.Y, -100000, 100000),
		math.clamp(position.Z, -100000, 100000)
	)

	humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(clamped)
end)

--!strict
-- ModuleScript: CoinService
-- Adds coins to a player's saved total in DataStore "PlayerData" (key "Player_" .. userId)
-- and returns the new total. Uses UpdateAsync so concurrent writes from other
-- servers are not lost, with bounded retries on failure.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2 -- seconds

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local CoinService = {}

local function attemptAddCoins(userId: number, amount: number): (boolean, number?)
	local key = "Player_" .. userId
	local success, result = false, nil

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, newTotal = pcall(function()
			return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				-- current may be nil for a brand-new key
				local currentTable = current
				if typeof(currentTable) ~= "table" then
					currentTable = { Coins = 0 }
				end
				currentTable.Coins = (currentTable.Coins or 0) + amount
				return currentTable
			end)
		end)

		if ok and newTotal and typeof(newTotal) == "table" then
			return true, newTotal.Coins
		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt) -- back off a little longer each retry
		end
	end

	return false, nil
end

function CoinService.addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number
	assert(typeof(userId) == "number", "addCoins: userId must be a number")
	assert(typeof(amount) == "number", "addCoins: amount must be a number")

	local success, newTotal = attemptAddCoins(userId, amount)

	if not success then
		-- The write never succeeded; do not pretend it did.
		error(("addCoins: failed to update coins for userId %d after %d attempts"):format(userId, MAX_RETRIES))
	end

	return newTotal :: number
end

return CoinService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveInventory(player)
	local inventoryJson = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if not inventoryJson then
		return -- nothing to save
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId

	-- Save to DataStore with bounded retries
	local saved = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldValue)
				-- Only overwrite if the read succeeded (oldValue may be nil for new players)
				return inventoryJson
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			saved = true
			break
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not saved then
		warn(("[InventorySave] Failed to save inventory for %s (%s); session data NOT saved."):format(player.Name, key))
		return
	end

	-- Post to analytics endpoint with bounded retries
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			HttpService:PostAsync(
				"https://example.com/log",
				HttpService:JSONEncode({
					userId = player.UserId,
					name = player.Name,
					inventory = inventoryJson,
				}),
				Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson
			)
		end)
		if ok then
			break
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		else
			warn(("[InventorySave] Failed to post analytics for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	saveInventory(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	-- Give leaving players a chance to save on studio shutdown / server close
	local remaining = Players:GetPlayers()
	local done = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(remaining) do
		task.spawn(function()
			saveInventory(player)
			done += 1
		end)
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 20
	while done < #remaining and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end

--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local KEY_PREFIX = "Player_"
local MAX_RETRIES = 5
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loaded = {} :: {[Player]: boolean}
local saving = {} :: {[Player]: boolean}

local function getCoinsValue(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then return nil end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function loadPlayer(player: Player)
	local coinsValue = getCoinsValue(player)
	if not coinsValue then return end

	local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if not ok then
		-- Read failed: never write a default over the key; skip saving this session.
		warn(("[PlayerData] Failed to load data for %s; saving disabled this session."):format(player.Name))
		loaded[player] = false
		return
	end

	loaded[player] = true
	coinsValue.Value = if typeof(data) == "number" then math.floor(data) else 0
end

local function savePlayer(player: Player): boolean
	if loaded[player] == false then
		return false -- load failed earlier; do not overwrite
	end
	if saving[player] then
		return false
	end
	saving[player] = true

	local coinsValue = getCoinsValue(player)
	local success = false

	if coinsValue then
		local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
		local amount = coinsValue.Value
		local ok = retry(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				-- Read the CURRENT value so concurrent writes from other servers aren't lost.
				local base = if typeof(current) == "table" and typeof(current.Coins) == "number"
					then current.Coins
					elseif typeof(current) == "number" then current
					else 0
				return { Coins = math.max(base, math.floor(amount)) }
			end)
		end)
		success = ok
	end

	saving[player] = nil
	if not success then
		warn(("[PlayerData] Failed to save data for %s; progress not saved."):format(player.Name))
	end
	return success
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	loadPlayer(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	savePlayer(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
	saving[player] = nil
end)

-- Nobody may lose progress when the server shuts down.
game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end

	local remaining = 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		remaining += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			savePlayer(player)
			remaining -= 1
		end)
	end

	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while remaining > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

-- ServerScriptService/PlayerCoins.server.luau
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function getKey(player: Player): string
	return "Player_" .. player.UserId
end

local function loadCoins(player: Player): (number?, boolean)
	local key = getKey(player)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key)
		end)
		if ok then
			-- nil means a brand-new player; a number is their saved coins
			if typeof(result) == "number" then
				return result, true
			end
			return 0, true
		end
		warn(("Failed to load coins for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return nil, false -- never succeeded; treat as unsaved, not a new account
end

local function saveCoins(player: Player, coins: number): boolean
	local key = getKey(player)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so a concurrent write from another server isn't lost
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				if typeof(old) == "number" and old > coins then
					return old -- never let a stale write reduce someone's coins
				end
				return coins
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins, loaded = loadCoins(player)
	if loaded then
		coinsValue.Value = coins :: number
	else
		-- Load failed: start at 0 for display, but DO NOT save this session
		-- so we never overwrite their real data with a default.
		coinsValue.Value = 0
		coinsValue:SetAttribute("SaveBlocked", true)
		warn(("Skipping save for %s this session because their data failed to load."):format(player.Name))
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end
	if coinsValue:GetAttribute("SaveBlocked") then
		return -- their load failed; don't overwrite real data with a default
	end
	saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

-- Handle players who joined before this script ran
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coinsValue and not coinsValue:GetAttribute("SaveBlocked") then
			saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
		end
	end
end)
